filesystem: Provides controlled access to files and folders through the configured MCP server.
postgres: Connects tools to a PostgreSQL database for schema inspection and database operations.
playwright: Controls a browser for page navigation, interaction, screenshots, and web testing.
git: Provides repository inspection and Git operations through an MCP server.
context7: Looks up current library documentation and code examples.
chrome-devtools: Controls and inspects Chrome through the DevTools protocol.
comfyui: Connects to ComfyUI workflows and image-generation services.
searxng: Provides privacy-focused web search and related retrieval tools through SearXNG.
searxng_search: Searches the web and returns ranked results with titles, links, and snippets.
searxng_image_search: Searches for images and returns image links, thumbnails, and available metadata.
searxng_news_search: Searches recent news articles with optional language and freshness filters.
searxng_video_search: Searches for videos and returns links, thumbnails, duration, and publisher details.
searxng_music_search: Searches for music and audio pages, including direct audio links when available.
searxng_paper_search: Searches scientific papers and returns publication metadata, abstracts, and PDF links.
searxng_fetch_content: Reads a public web page and returns its main content as clean Markdown.
searxng_search_and_fetch: Searches the web and fetches the full content of the best results in one request.
searxng_autocomplete: Returns query suggestions that can help refine a search phrase.
searxng_list_engines: Lists the search engines and categories available on the connected SearXNG instance.
searxng_doctor: Checks the connected SearXNG instance and reports search or configuration problems.
searxng_crawl_site: Crawls a website from a starting address and returns a page manifest for later reading.
searxng_deep_search: Runs an iterative multi-source search and returns a cited research dossier.
